environment.description: Celery worker running on shared EC2 instance (m5.large) in public subnet with multiple services co-located. Instance runs Amazon Linux 2, /tmp is a shared filesystem (no per-container isolation). Worker process runs as 'celery' user (uid 1000). Other application services (nginx reverse proxy, monitoring agents, log shippers) run on the same host under different UIDs but with read access to /tmp. The Celery broker (Redis) is accessible on the instance's public IP on port 6379 with no authentication (requirepass not set). Security group allows inbound on 6379/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0 due to misconfiguration during initial deployment.
